Running head and page number at the top.; One block of running text in one column, in the upper part of the scan; the lower part is blank. No margin notes. Signature mark at the foot of the text.

main_text.l: non possumus, neque omnibus simul objectis
realibus frui; estque necesse ut modò ex fa-
cultatibus unam ad objectum hoc appli-
cemus, modò aliam ad aliud tunc absens,
idque ordine & modis debitis; non posset
sane pro libertate nostra, neque ordinatim
& facile ista facultas & objectorum com-
mutatio sive successio fieri, nisi facultatem
quandam novi generis haberet Mens, quae
objecta absentia, eaque simul multa, ei de-
pingeret, ut ex illa pictura substitutione,
objectorum realium vices agente, memor
esset sese ad realia objecta absentia, sed re-
praesentata, convertendi; & de illis simul
repraesentatis in mente, idealiter dispo-
nendi, quae postea facultatum realium obje-
ctis veris communicatione exsequeretur.
Haec facultas depingendi nobis in mente ob-
jecta, quando tamen eorum realis praesen-
tia a suis cuique propriis facultatibus abest,
ea est quae Ratio humana sive intellectus a-
ctibus dicitur, feque extendit ad pingenda
quaevis tum spiritualia, tum corporea, Deum
videlicet, ejus attributa, resque creatas cæ-
teras, quarum picturæ vel icones ideæ jam
vulgo dicuntur, harumque idearum com-
plexus, comparatio, separatio, aliarum idea-
rum ex prioribus deductio, ratiocinia vel
ratiocinationes appellantur. Horum pri-
mum, Ratio videlicet, cùm sit eruditionis
superficiariæ efficiens causa, idea vero ejus
materia; ratiocinatio autem ejusdem tum
ampliandi tum communicandi instrumen-
tum; eorum proprietates affectionesve non
sunt.

page.notes: Marginal notes in the right margin are small italic type; their exact word breaks are partly uncertain, notably the opening "ventipi-ctuariam" and "umbra-tilem", which may be misread. Their placement beside the lines is approximate. The first word is cut at the left edge and is read as "ctibus" with a [?] for the first letter, since the lead-in is mostly lost; the line-end of the running text is partly faded. The signature "E 5" is printed mid-line, and the catchword-like "sunt" at the right is taken as the line's end word, not a catchword. Some words in the last line are faint.
